name: DataSling Series WM
description: Battery-powered multivariable LoRaWAN sensor (Series WM). One unit combines up to three inputs: differential pressure in in. WC (DP), humidity and temperature (HT) or gauge or wet/wet differential pressure in PSI (G, W), and thermistor probe temperature (TI), 4-20 mA input (AI) or 0-10 VDC input (VI). For HVAC, cleanrooms, pharmaceutical and industrial monitoring.
author: Sensocon, Inc.
